source.text: כָּרַ֥ע בֵּל֙ קֹרֵ֣ס נְב֔וֹ הָיוּ֙ עֲצַבֵּיהֶ֔ם לַחַיָּ֖ה וְלַבְּהֵמָ֑ה נְשֻׂאֹתֵיכֶ֣ם עֲמוּס֔וֹת מַשָּׂ֖א לַעֲיֵפָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: He has bowed down Bel, stooping Nebo; they are their idols for animals and for cattle; your carried [things are] loaded, a burden for a weary [beast].

en.L: Bel has bowed down; Nebo is stooping; \q their idols are [handed over] to animals and to cattle; \q the things you carry are loaded up, \q a burden for a weary [beast].
en.B: Bel crouches low; Nebo sinks down. \q Their idols are left to pack animals and cattle. \q The images you used to carry are packed up as cargo, \q a load for exhausted animals.
en.R: The gods Bel and Nebo bend down and fall. \q Their statues are tied onto the backs of animals. \q The idols you used to carry around are now heavy loads that wear the animals out.

es.L: Se ha inclinado Bel; se encorva Nebo; \q sus ídolos [quedan] para las bestias y para el ganado; \q las cosas que {{plural_you:ustedes llevaban|vosotros llevabais}} están cargadas, \q carga para [la bestia] cansada.
es.B: Bel se agacha; Nebo se derrumba. \q Sus ídolos quedan para las bestias de carga y el ganado. \q Las imágenes que {{plural_you:ustedes llevaban|vosotros llevabais}} en procesión van empacadas como carga, \q un peso para animales agotados.
es.R: Los dioses Bel y Nebo se doblan y caen. \q Sus estatuas van atadas sobre el lomo de los animales. \q Los ídolos que {{plural_you:ustedes llevaban|vosotros llevabais}} de un lado a otro ahora son cargas pesadas que agotan a los animales.

fr.L: Bel s’est courbé ; Nebo s’affaisse ; \q leurs idoles sont [livrées] aux bêtes et au bétail ; \q ce que vous portiez est chargé, \q un fardeau pour [la bête] fatiguée.
fr.B: Bel s’effondre, Nebo s’écroule. \q Leurs idoles sont abandonnées aux bêtes de somme et au bétail. \q Les statues que vous portiez en procession sont emballées comme des marchandises, \q une charge pour des bêtes épuisées.
fr.R: Les dieux Bel et Nebo se courbent et tombent. \q Leurs statues sont attachées sur le dos des animaux. \q Les idoles que vous portiez partout sont maintenant de lourdes charges qui épuisent les animaux.

sw.L: Beli ameinama; Nebo anajikunja; \q sanamu zao [zimekabidhiwa] wanyama na ng'ombe; \q vitu mnavyovibeba vimepakiwa, \q mzigo kwa [mnyama] aliyechoka.
sw.B: Beli anainama chini; Nebo anazama. \q Sanamu zao zimeachiwa wanyama wa kubeba mizigo na ng'ombe. \q Sanamu mlizozoea kuzibeba zimefungwa kama shehena, \q mzigo kwa wanyama waliochoka.
sw.R: Miungu Beli na Nebo inainama na kuanguka. \q Sanamu zao zimefungwa migongoni mwa wanyama. \q Sanamu mlizozoea kuzibeba huku na huko sasa ni mizigo mizito inayowachosha wanyama.

vi.L: Bên đã cúi xuống; Nê-bô đang khom mình; \q các tượng thần của chúng [bị giao] cho thú vật và gia súc; \q những vật các ngươi khiêng bị chất lên, \q làm gánh nặng cho [con vật] mệt mỏi.
vi.B: Thần Bên cúi rạp; thần Nê-bô khuỵu xuống. \q Tượng của chúng bị bỏ cho súc vật thồ và gia súc. \q Những tượng các ngươi thường khiêng nay bị chất lên như hàng hóa, \q thành gánh nặng cho những con vật kiệt sức.
vi.R: Các thần Bên và Nê-bô cúi xuống và ngã quỵ. \q Tượng của chúng bị buộc lên lưng súc vật. \q Những thần tượng các ngươi thường khiêng đi khắp nơi nay thành những gánh nặng làm súc vật mệt lả.

decisions.choice: Bel and Nebo: the chief gods of Babylon
decisions.reason: Bel means 'lord' and was a title of Marduk, the god of the city of Babylon. Nebo (Nabu) was counted as his son, the god of writing, worshiped at nearby Borsippa; his name is part of the names of Babylonian kings such as Nebuchadnezzar. At Babylon's New Year festival the statues of both gods were carried in procession through the city.

decisions.choice: has bowed down, is stooping: the gods collapse, pictured as their statues are toppled and taken away
decisions.reason: The verbs are used of someone who sinks to the knees or falls (10:4; 65:12). The scene is of the gods' statues being lowered and loaded onto animals, whether to be carried off by a conqueror or rescued in flight; verse 2 shows they end up in captivity.

decisions.choice: your carried things are loaded: the idols that used to be carried with honor are now freight
decisions.reason: The word for the things carried is used of loads; the verb 'loaded' returns in verse 3, where God says he has carried Israel. The people addressed as 'you' are those who carried the idols, the worshipers of Babylon.

decisions.choice: The gods Bel and Nebo; statues tied onto the backs of animals
decisions.reason: Readable says that Bel and Nebo are gods and makes plain that it is their statues that are loaded on the animals.

decisions.choice: Bel y Nebo
decisions.reason: The names of the two gods of Babylon in the form the terms note sets; Readable says that they are gods, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Beli; Nebo
decisions.reason: The gods of Babylon in the Swahili spelling of the terms note; Beli is not Baal, though the name means "lord" too (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: "Bên" and "Nê-bô"; "thần Bên", "thần Nê-bô" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the terms note settles for the gods of Babylon; "Nê-bô" is the published form (1 Chronicles 5:8). Balanced and Readable add "thần" (god) so that a reader knows who they are, as the English Readable says "the gods".

source.text: קָרְס֤וּ כָֽרְעוּ֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו לֹ֥א יָכְל֖וּ מַלֵּ֣ט מַשָּׂ֑א וְנַפְשָׁ֖ם בַּשְּׁבִ֥י הָלָֽכָה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: They have stooped, they have bowed down together; not they have been able to rescue [the] burden, and their self into captivity it has gone.

en.L: They stoop, they bow down together; \q they have not been able to rescue the burden, \q and they themselves have gone into captivity.
en.B: Together they crouch and stoop. \q They cannot save the load, \q and they themselves are led away as captives.
en.R: These gods bend over and fall together. \q They cannot save their own statues from being carried away. \q The gods themselves are taken away as prisoners.

es.L: Se encorvan, se inclinan a una; \q no han podido librar la carga, \q y ellos mismos han ido en cautiverio.
es.B: A la vez se agachan y se doblan. \q No pueden salvar la carga, \q y ellos mismos son llevados cautivos.
es.R: Estos dioses se doblan y caen juntos. \q No pueden salvar sus propias estatuas de que se las lleven. \q Los dioses mismos son llevados como prisioneros.

fr.L: Ils se courbent, ils s’affaissent ensemble ; \q ils n’ont pas pu sauver le fardeau, \q et eux-mêmes sont allés en captivité.
fr.B: Ensemble ils se courbent et s’effondrent. \q Ils ne peuvent pas sauver la charge, \q et eux-mêmes sont emmenés en captivité.
fr.R: Ces dieux se penchent et tombent ensemble. \q Ils ne peuvent pas empêcher qu’on emporte leurs propres statues. \q Les dieux eux-mêmes sont emmenés comme prisonniers.

sw.L: Wanajikunja, wanainama pamoja; \q hawakuweza kuuokoa mzigo, \q na wao wenyewe wamekwenda utumwani.
sw.B: Kwa pamoja wanainama na kujikunja. \q Hawawezi kuuokoa mzigo, \q nao wenyewe wanachukuliwa kama mateka.
sw.R: Miungu hii inainama na kuanguka pamoja. \q Haiwezi kuzizuia sanamu zake zisichukuliwe. \q Miungu yenyewe inachukuliwa kama wafungwa.

vi.L: Chúng khom mình, chúng cùng nhau cúi xuống; \q chúng đã không thể giải cứu gánh nặng, \q và chính chúng đã đi vào cảnh lưu đày.
vi.B: Chúng cùng nhau khuỵu xuống và cúi rạp. \q Chúng không cứu nổi gánh hàng, \q và chính chúng bị dẫn đi làm tù binh.
vi.R: Các thần ấy cùng nhau cúi xuống và ngã quỵ. \q Chúng không thể cứu tượng của chính mình khỏi bị mang đi. \q Chính các thần ấy cũng bị bắt đi làm tù binh.

decisions.choice: rescue the burden: the gods cannot rescue the load, that is, their own images on the animals' backs
alternatives: the people who carried the idols
decisions.reason: The 'burden' points back to verse 1. A god that cannot save its own statue cannot save its worshipers either (verse 7). Some take the burden to be the weary animals or the people who carried the idols, but the sense is the same: the gods are helpless.

decisions.choice: they themselves have gone into captivity: conquerors carried off the gods of defeated peoples
decisions.reason: The word translated 'themselves' is the one for a living self (soul). Taking a nation's gods into exile was a common act of conquest in the ancient Near East (Jeremiah 48:7; 49:3). The past tense describes what is coming as already done.

decisions.choice: their own statues from being carried away
decisions.reason: Readable explains what 'the burden' is, following verse 1.

source.text: שִׁמְע֤וּ אֵלַי֙ בֵּ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְכָל־שְׁאֵרִ֖ית בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הַֽעֲמֻסִים֙ מִנִּי־בֶ֔טֶן הַנְּשֻׂאִ֖ים מִנִּי־רָֽחַם׃

records.literal_gloss: Listen to me, house of Jacob, and all [the] remnant of [the] house of Israel, the [ones] loaded from [the] belly, the [ones] carried from [the] womb.

en.L: Listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, O house of Jacob, \q and all the remnant of the house of Israel, \q who have been loaded [on {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}] from the belly, \q who have been carried from the womb:
en.B: Listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, house of Jacob, \q all who remain of the house of Israel, \q you whom I have carried as {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} load since birth, \q whom I have borne since you came from the womb.
en.R: Listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, you descendants of Jacob, all you people of Israel who are still left. \q I have carried you since the day you were born. \q I have held you up from the very start of your life.

es.L: {{plural_you:Escúchenme|Escuchadme}} a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, oh casa de Jacob, \q y todo el remanente de la casa de Israel, \q los que han sido cargados [por {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}] desde el vientre, \q los que han sido llevados desde la matriz:
es.B: {{plural_you:Escúchenme|Escuchadme}} a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, casa de Jacob, \q todos los que quedan de la casa de Israel, \q {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, a quienes he llevado como {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} carga desde que nacieron, \q a quienes he sostenido desde que salieron del vientre.
es.R: {{plural_you:Escúchenme|Escuchadme}} a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, descendientes de Jacob, todos los del pueblo de Israel que todavía quedan. \q {{plural_you:Los he llevado en brazos desde el día en que nacieron|Os he llevado en brazos desde el día en que nacisteis}}. \q {{plural_you:Los he sostenido desde el comienzo mismo de su vida|Os he sostenido desde el comienzo mismo de vuestra vida}}.

fr.L: Écoutez-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, maison de Jacob, \q et tout le reste de la maison d’Israël, \q vous qui avez été chargés [sur {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}] dès le ventre, \q portés dès le sein maternel :
fr.B: Écoutez-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, maison de Jacob, \q vous tous, le reste de la maison d’Israël, \q vous que j’ai portés comme {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} charge depuis votre naissance, \q que j’ai soutenus depuis que vous êtes sortis du sein de votre mère.
fr.R: Écoutez-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, descendants de Jacob, vous tous, gens d’Israël qui êtes encore là. \q Je vous porte depuis le jour de votre naissance. \q Je vous soutiens depuis le tout début de votre vie.

sw.L: Nisikilizeni, Ee nyumba ya Yakobo, \q na mabaki yote ya nyumba ya Israeli, \q mliopakiwa [juu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}] tangu tumboni, \q mliobebwa tangu mimbani:
sw.B: Nisikilizeni, nyumba ya Yakobo, \q nyote mliobaki wa nyumba ya Israeli, \q ninyi ambao nimewabeba kama mzigo {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} tangu kuzaliwa, \q ambao nimewachukua tangu mlipotoka tumboni.
sw.R: Nisikilizeni, enyi wazao wa Yakobo, ninyi nyote watu wa Israeli mliobaki. \q Nimewabeba tangu siku mlipozaliwa. \q Nimewashika tangu mwanzo kabisa wa maisha yenu.

vi.L: Hãy nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, hỡi nhà Gia-cốp, \q và mọi kẻ sót lại của nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên, \q những kẻ đã được chất [trên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}] từ trong bụng, \q những kẻ đã được bồng ẵm từ trong lòng mẹ:
vi.B: Hãy lắng nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, hỡi nhà Gia-cốp, \q hỡi tất cả những người còn sót lại của nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên, \q các ngươi là những kẻ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã mang như gánh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} từ khi lọt lòng, \q đã bồng ẵm từ lúc ra khỏi lòng mẹ.
vi.R: Hãy nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, hỡi con cháu Gia-cốp, hỡi tất cả những người Y-sơ-ra-ên còn sống sót. \q Ta đã mang các ngươi từ ngày các ngươi ra đời. \q Ta đã nâng đỡ các ngươi từ lúc đời các ngươi mới bắt đầu.

decisions.choice: loaded, carried: God carries his people, unlike the idols that must be carried
decisions.reason: The two verbs are the same ones used of the idols in verse 1 ('loaded', 'burden'). The gods of Babylon have to be carried by animals; the God of Israel has carried his people all their life (40:11; 63:9; Deuteronomy 1:31; Exodus 19:4).

decisions.choice: from the belly, from the womb: from the very beginning of the nation's life
decisions.reason: Israel is pictured as a child God has carried since birth (44:2, 24). The verbs are passive; the next verse shows that God is the one who carries.

decisions.choice: I have carried you
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name God, the speaker, as the one who carries; the Hebrew passive leaves him implied, as verse 4 makes plain.

decisions.choice: you descendants of Jacob
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly that the 'house of Jacob' is his family line, the people of Israel.

decisions.choice: el remanente (L, B); los que todavía quedan (R)
decisions.reason: Book-wide for *sheʾar* in this block, as Romans 9:27 and 11:5: "remanente" at Literal and Balanced, "los que quedan" at Readable.

decisions.choice: mabaki (Literal); nyote mliobaki (Balanced); mliobaki (Readable)
decisions.reason: The remnant is "mabaki", as Romans 9:27 and 2 Kings 19:31, at Literal; Balanced and Readable say "those who are left" where the line addresses them directly. The verbs "pakiwa" and "bebwa" are those used of the idols in verse 1.

decisions.choice: "le reste" (L, B); "gens d'Israël qui êtes encore là" (R)
decisions.reason: The remnant is "le reste" at Literal and Balanced, as Romans 9:27 and 2 Kings 19:31; Readable says plainly who is meant ("ceux qui resteront", "les survivants"). Settled for chapters 41-66.

decisions.choice: "những kẻ sót lại" (L); "những người còn sót lại" (B); "những người ... còn sống sót" (R)
decisions.reason: As the terms note settles for she'ar (the remnant), following 2 Kings 19:4, 31.

source.text: וְעַד־זִקְנָה֙ אֲנִ֣י ה֔וּא וְעַד־שֵיבָ֖האֲנִ֣י אֶסְבֹּ֑ל אֲנִ֤י עָשִׂ֨יתִי֙ וַאֲנִ֣י אֶשָּׂ֔א וַאֲנִ֥י אֶסְבֹּ֖ל וַאֲמַלֵּֽט׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And until old age I [am] he, and until gray hair I, I will carry; I, I have made, and I, I will bear, and I, I will carry and I will rescue.

en.L: And even to [your] old age I [am] he, \q and to gray hair I will carry [you]; \q I have made [you], and I will bear [you], \q and I will carry [you] and rescue [you].
en.B: Until you are old I am he, \q and until your hair turns gray I am the one who will carry you. \q I made you, and I will lift you; \q I will carry you and bring you to safety.
en.R: Even when you are old, I will be the same God. \q Even when your hair turns gray, I will carry you. \q I made you, and I will hold you up. \q I will carry you and save you.

es.L: Y hasta la vejez yo [soy] él, \q y hasta las canas yo [{{plural_you:los|os}}] llevaré; \q yo [{{plural_you:los|os}}] hice, y yo [{{plural_you:los|os}}] cargaré, \q y yo [{{plural_you:los|os}}] llevaré y [{{plural_you:los|os}}] libraré.
es.B: Hasta que {{plural_you:lleguen a viejos|lleguéis a viejos}}, yo soy, \q y hasta que se {{plural_you:les|os}} vuelva gris el cabello, yo soy quien {{plural_you:los|os}} llevará. \q Yo {{plural_you:los|os}} hice, y yo {{plural_you:los|os}} levantaré; \q yo {{plural_you:los|os}} llevaré y {{plural_you:los|os}} pondré a salvo.
es.R: Aun cuando {{plural_you:sean viejos|seáis viejos}}, seré el mismo Dios. \q Aun cuando {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} canas, {{plural_you:los|os}} llevaré en brazos. \q Yo {{plural_you:los|os}} hice, y yo {{plural_you:los|os}} sostendré. \q {{plural_you:Los|Os}} llevaré y {{plural_you:los|os}} salvaré.

fr.L: Et jusqu’à [votre] vieillesse, c’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, \q et jusqu’aux cheveux blancs, moi, je [vous] porterai ; \q moi, je [vous] ai faits, et moi, je [vous] soutiendrai, \q et moi, je [vous] porterai et [vous] délivrerai.
fr.B: Jusqu’à votre vieillesse, c’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, \q et jusqu’à ce que vos cheveux blanchissent, c’est moi qui vous porterai. \q Je vous ai faits, et je vous soulèverai ; \q je vous porterai et je vous mettrai à l’abri.
fr.R: Même quand vous serez vieux, je serai toujours le même Dieu. \q Même quand vos cheveux deviendront blancs, je vous porterai. \q Je vous ai faits, et je vous soutiendrai. \q Je vous porterai et je vous sauverai.

sw.L: Na hata uzee [wenu] {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndiye, \q na hata mvi nitawabeba; \q nimewafanya, nami nitawachukua, \q nami nitawabeba na kuwaokoa.
sw.B: Hata mtakapozeeka {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndiye, \q na hata nywele zenu zitakapokuwa na mvi {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndiye nitakayewabeba. \q Niliwafanya, nami nitawainua; \q nitawabeba na kuwafikisha salama.
sw.R: Hata mtakapokuwa wazee, nitakuwa Mungu yuleyule. \q Hata nywele zenu zitakapokuwa na mvi, nitawabeba. \q Niliwaumba, nami nitawashikilia. \q Nitawabeba na kuwaokoa.

vi.L: Và cho đến [khi các ngươi] già, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [vẫn là] Đấng ấy, \q và cho đến khi tóc bạc, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ mang [các ngươi]; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm nên [các ngươi], và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ bồng ẵm [các ngươi], \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ mang [các ngươi] và giải cứu [các ngươi].
vi.B: Cho đến khi các ngươi già, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vẫn là Đấng ấy, \q cho đến khi tóc các ngươi bạc, chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ mang các ngươi. \q Ta đã làm nên các ngươi, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ nâng các ngươi lên; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ mang các ngươi và đưa các ngươi đến nơi an toàn.
vi.R: Ngay cả khi các ngươi già, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vẫn là Đức Chúa Trời như xưa. \q Ngay cả khi tóc các ngươi bạc, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ mang các ngươi. \q Ta đã làm nên các ngươi, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ nâng đỡ các ngươi. \q Ta sẽ mang các ngươi và cứu các ngươi.

decisions.choice: I am he; I, I, I: God stresses that he himself does this
decisions.reason: The pronoun 'I' is written out five times, which Hebrew does not need, for emphasis: it is God himself who carries, not someone else and not an idol. 'I am he' says that God remains the same, the one true God (41:4; 43:10, 13; 48:12).

decisions.choice: until old age, until gray hair: to the end of life
decisions.reason: God, who carried Israel from birth (verse 3), will carry the people through to old age. The contrast is with idols that grow heavy and wear out the animals that carry them (verse 1).

decisions.choice: carry you, made you, lift you, rescue you
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verbs have no object; verse 3 shows that the object is Israel.

decisions.choice: I will be the same God
decisions.reason: Readable explains 'I am he' as God remaining the same; see the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: "je serai toujours le même Dieu"
decisions.reason: Here *ʾani hu* stresses that God stays the same through Israel's whole life, so Readable follows the English Readable rather than the "moi seul, je suis Dieu" used where the phrase claims to be the only God.

records.literal_gloss: To whom will you liken me and make equal, and compare me, that we may be alike?

en.L: To whom will you liken {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and make [{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}] equal, \q and compare {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, that we may be alike?
en.B: Whom will you hold up as {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} likeness, or rank as {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} equal? \q Whom will you set beside {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, as though we were alike?
en.R: Who do you think is like {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}? Who could be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} equal? \q Can you find anyone to put beside {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and say that we are the same?

es.L: ¿A quién {{plural_you:me asemejarán y me igualarán|me asemejaréis y me igualaréis}}, \q y {{plural_you:me compararán|me compararéis}}, para que seamos semejantes?
es.B: ¿A quién {{plural_you:pondrán|pondréis}} como {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} semejante, o {{plural_you:tendrán|tendréis}} por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} igual? \q ¿A quién {{plural_you:pondrán|pondréis}} junto a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, como si fuéramos iguales?
es.R: ¿Quién {{plural_you:creen|creéis}} que es como yo? ¿Quién podría ser {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} igual? \q ¿{{plural_you:Pueden|Podéis}} encontrar a alguien para ponerlo junto a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} y decir que somos iguales?

fr.L: À qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} comparerez-vous et {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}égalerez-vous, \q et à qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} rapprocherez-vous, pour que nous soyons semblables ?
fr.B: À qui voulez-vous {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} comparer, qui voulez-vous mettre à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} rang ? \q Qui placerez-vous à côté de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, comme si nous étions pareils ?
fr.R: Qui, d’après vous, est comme {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ? Qui pourrait être {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} égal ? \q Pouvez-vous trouver quelqu’un à mettre à côté de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} en disant que nous sommes pareils ?

sw.L: Mtanifananisha na nani na kunifanya sawa [naye], \q na kunilinganisha, ili tufanane?
sw.B: Ni nani mtakayemwonyesha kuwa mfano {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, au kumweka kuwa sawa {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}}? \q Ni nani mtakayemweka kando {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, kana kwamba tunafanana?
sw.R: Mnadhani ni nani aliye kama {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}? Ni nani anayeweza kuwa sawa {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}}? \q Je, mnaweza kumpata yeyote wa kumweka kando {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} na kusema kwamba tunafanana?

vi.L: Các ngươi sẽ so sánh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} với ai và làm cho [{{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}] ngang bằng, \q và ví {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [với ai], để chúng ta giống nhau?
vi.B: Các ngươi sẽ đưa ai ra làm hình ảnh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, hay xếp ai ngang hàng với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}? \q Các ngươi sẽ đặt ai bên cạnh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, như thể chúng ta giống nhau?
vi.R: Các ngươi nghĩ ai giống như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}? Ai có thể ngang hàng với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}? \q Các ngươi có thể tìm được ai để đặt bên cạnh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và nói rằng chúng ta như nhau không?

decisions.choice: To whom will you liken me: God repeats the challenge he made before
decisions.reason: The same question is asked in 40:18 and 40:25, each time followed by a description of idols being made, as here in verse 6.

decisions.choice: that we may be alike: a question that expects the answer 'no one'
decisions.reason: The four verbs all mean to compare or match. The question is rhetorical: nothing can be set beside God.

source.text: הַזָּלִ֤ים זָהָב֙ מִכִּ֔יס וְכֶ֖סֶף בַּקָּנֶ֣ה יִשְׁקֹ֑לוּ יִשְׂכְּר֤וּ צוֹרֵף֙ וְיַעֲשֵׂ֣הוּ אֵ֔ל יִסְגְּד֖וּ אַף־יִֽשְׁתַּחֲוּֽוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Those pouring out gold from [the] bag, and silver on the scale they weigh; they hire a smith, and he makes it a god; they bow down, yes, they prostrate themselves.

en.L: Those who pour out gold from the bag \q and weigh out silver on the scale \q hire a smith, and he makes it [into] a god; \q they bow down, yes, they fall prostrate.
en.B: Some empty gold from their purses and weigh out silver on the balance. \q They pay a craftsman to shape it into a god, \q then fall on their faces before it and bow low.
en.R: People take gold out of their bags and weigh their silver. \q They pay a skilled worker to make a god out of it. \q Then they bow down to the ground and worship it.

es.L: Los que derrochan el oro de la bolsa \q y pesan la plata en la balanza \q contratan a un platero, y él lo hace un dios; \q se inclinan, sí, se postran.
es.B: Algunos vacían el oro de sus bolsas y pesan la plata en la balanza. \q Le pagan a un orfebre para que les haga un dios, \q y luego se postran ante él y se inclinan hasta el suelo.
es.R: La gente saca oro de sus bolsas y pesa su plata. \q Le paga a un artesano para que haga un dios con ella. \q Después se inclinan hasta el suelo y lo adoran.

fr.L: Ceux qui versent l’or de la bourse \q et pèsent l’argent à la balance \q engagent un orfèvre, et il en fait un dieu ; \q ils s’inclinent, oui, ils se prosternent.
fr.B: Certains vident l’or de leur bourse et pèsent l’argent sur la balance. \q Ils paient un artisan pour en faire un dieu, \q puis ils tombent face contre terre devant lui et se prosternent.
fr.R: Des gens sortent de l’or de leurs sacs et pèsent leur argent. \q Ils paient un ouvrier habile pour qu’il en fasse un dieu. \q Puis ils se prosternent jusqu’à terre et l’adorent.

sw.L: Wale wamwagao dhahabu kutoka mfukoni \q na kupima fedha kwa mizani \q humwajiri mfua dhahabu, naye huifanya [kuwa] mungu; \q huisujudia, naam, huanguka kifudifudi.
sw.B: Wengine humimina dhahabu kutoka mifuko yao na kupima fedha kwa mizani. \q Humlipa fundi aitengeneze kuwa mungu, \q kisha huanguka kifudifudi mbele yake na kuinama chini.
sw.R: Watu wanatoa dhahabu katika mifuko yao na kupima fedha zao. \q Wanamlipa fundi stadi awatengenezee mungu kwa madini hayo. \q Kisha wanainama hadi chini na kuuabudu.

vi.L: Những kẻ đổ vàng ra từ túi \q và cân bạc trên cân \q thuê một thợ kim hoàn, và người làm nó [thành] một vị thần; \q chúng cúi xuống, phải, chúng sấp mình xuống.
vi.B: Có kẻ dốc vàng trong túi ra và cân bạc trên bàn cân. \q Chúng thuê thợ đúc để làm nó thành một vị thần, \q rồi sấp mặt xuống trước nó mà cúi lạy.
vi.R: Người ta lấy vàng trong túi ra và cân bạc của mình. \q Họ trả tiền cho một người thợ giỏi để làm một vị thần từ số vàng bạc ấy. \q Rồi họ cúi rạp xuống đất mà thờ lạy nó.

decisions.choice: pour out, weigh: spend lavishly
decisions.reason: The first verb is used of spending freely or wastefully (Proverbs 23:20, 'gluttons'). There were no coins: silver was paid out by weight on a balance (Genesis 23:16; Jeremiah 32:9).

decisions.choice: a smith: a metalworker who refines and casts gold and silver
decisions.reason: The same word is used for the craftsman who overlays an idol with gold in 40:19 and 41:7.

decisions.choice: bow down, prostrate themselves: full worship of the image
decisions.reason: The first verb is used in Isaiah only of bowing before an idol (44:15, 17, 19); the second is the usual word for worship by lying face down. Together they describe worship given to something human hands have just made.

source.text: יִ֠שָּׂאֻהוּ עַל־כָּתֵ֨ף יִסְבְּלֻ֜הוּ וְיַנִּיחֻ֤הוּ תַחְתָּיו֙ וְיַֽעֲמֹ֔ד מִמְּקוֹמ֖וֹ לֹ֣א יָמִ֑ישׁ אַף־יִצְעַ֤ק אֵלָיו֙ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲנֶ֔ה מִצָּרָת֖וֹ לֹ֥א יוֹשִׁיעֶֽנּוּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: They lift it up on [the] shoulder, they carry it, and they set it down in its place, and it stands; from its place not it moves. Also [one] cries out to it, and not it answers; from his trouble not it saves him.

en.L: They lift it on [the] shoulder; they carry it and set it down in its place, and it stands; \q from its place it does not move. \q Also [one] cries out to it, and it does not answer; \q from his trouble it does not save him.
en.B: They heave it onto their shoulders and haul it, and set it down where it belongs. \q There it stays; it cannot budge from the spot. \q A person may cry out to it, but it makes no reply; \q it saves no one from distress.
en.R: They lift the idol onto their shoulders and carry it. \q They put it in its place, and it stands there. It cannot move! \q People cry out to it for help, but it does not answer. \q It cannot save anyone from their troubles.

es.L: Lo alzan sobre el hombro; lo llevan y lo ponen en su lugar, y allí está; \q de su lugar no se mueve. \q También [uno] le clama, y no responde; \q de su angustia no lo salva.
es.B: Se lo echan al hombro y lo cargan, y lo ponen donde le corresponde. \q Allí se queda; no puede moverse de su sitio. \q Uno puede clamar a él, pero no contesta; \q no salva a nadie de su angustia.
es.R: Levantan el ídolo sobre los hombros y lo llevan. \q Lo ponen en su lugar, y allí se queda. ¡No se puede mover! \q La gente le pide ayuda a gritos, pero no responde. \q No puede salvar a nadie de sus problemas.

fr.L: Ils le soulèvent sur l’épaule ; ils le portent et le déposent à sa place, et il se tient debout ; \q de sa place il ne bouge pas. \q On crie aussi vers lui, et il ne répond pas ; \q de sa détresse il ne le sauve pas.
fr.B: Ils le hissent sur leurs épaules et le transportent, puis le posent à l’endroit prévu. \q Il y reste ; il ne peut pas bouger de là. \q On a beau crier vers lui, il ne répond rien ; \q il ne sauve personne de la détresse.
fr.R: Ils soulèvent l’idole sur leurs épaules et la portent. \q Ils la mettent à sa place, et elle reste là. Elle ne peut pas bouger ! \q Les gens crient vers elle pour avoir de l’aide, mais elle ne répond pas. \q Elle ne peut sauver personne de ses malheurs.

sw.L: Wanaiinua begani; wanaibeba na kuiweka mahali pake, nayo inasimama; \q kutoka mahali pake haitoki. \q Pia [mtu] anaililia, nayo haijibu; \q kutoka katika taabu yake haimwokoi.
sw.B: Wanaipandisha mabegani na kuibeba, na kuiweka mahali pake. \q Pale inakaa; haiwezi kusogea hata kidogo. \q Mtu anaweza kuililia, lakini haimjibu; \q haimwokoi mtu yeyote katika dhiki.
sw.R: Wanaiinua sanamu mabegani na kuibeba. \q Wanaiweka mahali pake, nayo inasimama pale. Haiwezi kutembea! \q Watu wanaililia ili iwasaidie, lakini haijibu. \q Haiwezi kumwokoa mtu yeyote katika taabu zake.

vi.L: Chúng vác nó lên vai; chúng khiêng nó và đặt nó vào chỗ của nó, và nó đứng đó; \q nó không rời khỏi chỗ của nó. \q Dù [ai] kêu cầu nó, nó cũng không đáp lời; \q nó không cứu người khỏi cơn hoạn nạn.
vi.B: Chúng nhấc nó lên vai mà khiêng đi, rồi đặt nó vào chỗ của nó. \q Nó đứng yên đó, không thể nhúc nhích khỏi chỗ. \q Có ai kêu cầu nó, nó cũng chẳng trả lời; \q nó không cứu được ai khỏi cảnh khốn cùng.
vi.R: Họ nhấc thần tượng lên vai và khiêng nó đi. \q Họ đặt nó vào chỗ của nó, và nó đứng đó. Nó không thể cử động! \q Người ta kêu cầu nó giúp đỡ, nhưng nó không trả lời. \q Nó không thể cứu ai khỏi những nỗi khó khăn của họ.

decisions.choice: they carry it, it does not move: the idol has to be carried and cannot act
decisions.reason: The verse sums up the contrast of the chapter: people carry their god (verse 1), but God carries his people (verses 3-4). The idol cannot even move from where it is put (40:20; 41:7; Jeremiah 10:5).

decisions.choice: one cries out, it does not save him: anyone who prays to it
decisions.reason: The singular verb has no named subject; it means any worshiper. The idol neither answers nor rescues, which God alone does (45:20-22).

decisions.choice: it saves no one; save anyone
decisions.reason: The Hebrew 'him' means any worshiper, man or woman; Balanced and Readable use a general word.

records.literal_gloss: Remember this and show yourselves firm; bring [it] back, rebels, to heart.

en.L: Remember this and show yourselves firm; \q bring [it] back to [your] heart, [you] rebels.
en.B: Remember this and steady yourselves; \q think it through again, you rebels.
en.R: Remember this and be strong. \q You rebels, think about it carefully.

es.L: {{plural_you:Recuerden esto y muéstrense|Recordad esto y mostraos}} firmes; \q {{plural_you:tráiganlo|traedlo}} de nuevo al corazón, rebeldes.
es.B: {{plural_you:Recuerden esto y manténganse|Recordad esto y manteneos}} firmes; \q {{plural_you:vuelvan|volved}} a pensarlo, rebeldes.
es.R: {{plural_you:Recuerden esto y sean|Recordad esto y sed}} fuertes. \q Rebeldes, {{plural_you:piénsenlo|pensadlo}} bien.

fr.L: Souvenez-vous de cela et montrez-vous fermes ; \q ramenez[-le] à [votre] cœur, rebelles.
fr.B: Souvenez-vous de cela et tenez bon ; \q réfléchissez-y encore, rebelles.
fr.R: Souvenez-vous de cela et soyez forts. \q Vous, les rebelles, réfléchissez bien.

sw.L: Kumbukeni hili na mjionyeshe imara; \q lirudisheni moyoni [mwenu], [enyi] waasi.
sw.B: Kumbukeni hili na mjitie nguvu; \q lifikirieni tena, enyi waasi.
sw.R: Kumbukeni jambo hili na muwe hodari. \q Enyi waasi, lifikirieni kwa makini.

vi.L: Hãy nhớ điều này và tỏ ra vững vàng; \q hãy đem [điều ấy] trở lại trong lòng, [hỡi những kẻ] phản nghịch.
vi.B: Hãy nhớ điều này và đứng cho vững; \q hãy suy nghĩ lại cho kỹ, hỡi những kẻ phản nghịch.
vi.R: Hãy nhớ điều này và hãy mạnh mẽ. \q Hỡi những kẻ phản nghịch, hãy suy nghĩ kỹ về điều đó.

decisions.choice: show yourselves firm: be steady, act with resolve
decisions.reason: The verb occurs only here in the Hebrew Bible. It seems to come from the word for a man, giving 'act like a man, be firm'. Others connect it with a root meaning to be ashamed or to take heed; the sense of the line is uncertain.

decisions.choice: rebels: the Israelites who were drawn to idols
decisions.reason: The word is used of those who break faith with God (1:28; 48:8). God is still addressing the house of Jacob (verse 3).

decisions.choice: bring it back to heart: think it over again
decisions.reason: The heart is the seat of thought; bringing something back to it means to reconsider (44:19; Deuteronomy 4:39).

source.text: זִכְר֥וּ רִאשֹׁנ֖וֹת מֵעוֹלָ֑ם כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֥י אֵל֙ וְאֵ֣ין ע֔וֹד אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְאֶ֥פֶס כָּמֽוֹנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Remember [the] former [things] from long ago, for I [am] God, and there is no other; God, and there is none like me,

en.L: Remember the former [things] from long ago, \q for I [am] God, and there is no other; \q [I am] God, and there is none like {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}},
en.B: Remember what happened long ago, in ages past: \q I alone am God, and there is no other; \q I am God, and none can compare with {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.R: Remember the things I did long ago. \q I am God, and there is no other God. \q I am God, and no one is like {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: {{plural_you:Recuerden|Recordad}} las cosas primeras desde la antigüedad, \q porque yo [soy] Dios, y no hay otro; \q [soy] Dios, y no hay nadie como yo,
es.B: {{plural_you:Recuerden|Recordad}} lo que sucedió hace mucho, en tiempos pasados: \q solo yo soy Dios, y no hay otro; \q yo soy Dios, y nadie se puede comparar {{deity_pronoun:conmigo|Conmigo}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Recuerden|Recordad}} las cosas que hice hace mucho tiempo. \q Yo soy Dios, y no hay otro Dios. \q Yo soy Dios, y nadie es como yo.

fr.L: Souvenez-vous des choses d’autrefois, depuis longtemps, \q car je [suis] Dieu, et il n’y en a pas d’autre ; \q [je suis] Dieu, et nul n’est comme {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}},
fr.B: Souvenez-vous de ce qui s’est passé il y a longtemps, aux temps anciens : \q moi seul, je suis Dieu, et il n’y en a pas d’autre ; \q je suis Dieu, et personne ne peut {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}être comparé.
fr.R: Souvenez-vous de ce que j’ai fait il y a longtemps. \q Je suis Dieu, et il n’y a pas d’autre Dieu. \q Je suis Dieu, et personne n’est comme {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.

sw.L: Kumbukeni mambo ya kwanza ya zamani za kale, \q kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] Mungu, wala hakuna mwingine; \q [{{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni] Mungu, wala hakuna aliye kama {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}},
sw.B: Kumbukeni yaliyotokea zamani, katika nyakati za kale: \q {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} peke {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ndiye Mungu, wala hakuna mwingine; \q {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni Mungu, wala hakuna awezaye kulinganishwa {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}}.
sw.R: Kumbukeni mambo niliyoyafanya zamani. \q Mimi ni Mungu, wala hakuna Mungu mwingine. \q Mimi ni Mungu, wala hakuna aliye kama {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}.

vi.L: Hãy nhớ những [việc] trước kia từ thuở xa xưa, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] Đức Chúa Trời, và chẳng có ai khác; \q [{{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là] Đức Chúa Trời, và chẳng có ai giống như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}},
vi.B: Hãy nhớ lại những việc đã xảy ra từ lâu, từ những thời xa xưa: \q chỉ một mình {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Đức Chúa Trời, chẳng có ai khác; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Đức Chúa Trời, chẳng ai có thể sánh với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Hãy nhớ những việc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm từ lâu. \q Ta là Đức Chúa Trời, và chẳng có Đức Chúa Trời nào khác. \q Ta là Đức Chúa Trời, và chẳng có ai giống như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

decisions.choice: the former things from long ago: the events of Israel's past, which God foretold and brought about
decisions.reason: In these chapters 'the former things' are what God announced beforehand and then did (41:22; 42:9; 43:18; 48:3). His past acts prove that he alone is God.

decisions.choice: I am God, and there is no other: God alone is God
decisions.reason: The verse uses two words for God (El and Elohim). The claim is repeated through these chapters (43:10-11; 44:6; 45:5, 21-22). Babylon will claim the same words for herself in 47:8 and 47:10.

decisions.choice: the things I did
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly that the 'former things' are God's own acts.

source.text: מַגִּ֤יד מֵֽרֵאשִׁית֙ אַחֲרִ֔ית וּמִקֶּ֖דֶם אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־נַעֲשׂ֑וּ אֹמֵר֙ עֲצָתִ֣י תָק֔וּם וְכָל־חֶפְצִ֖י אֶעֱשֶֽׂה׃

records.literal_gloss: declaring from [the] beginning [the] end, and from antiquity [things] which not have been done, saying, My purpose will stand, and all my desire I will do,

en.L: declaring from [the] beginning the end, \q and from ancient times [things] that have not [yet] been done, \q saying, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} purpose will stand, \q and all {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} desire I will do,
en.B: From the start I announce how things will end, \q and from ages past what has not yet happened. \q I say that {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} plan will stand \q and that I will carry out all that I desire.
en.R: Even at the very beginning I tell what will happen at the end. \q Long ago I told about things that had not happened yet. \q I say that {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} plans will come true. \q I will do everything I want to do.

es.L: que anuncio desde el principio el fin, \q y desde antiguo lo que aún no se ha hecho, \q que digo: {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} consejo permanecerá, \q y haré todo lo que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} place,
es.B: Desde el comienzo anuncio cómo terminarán las cosas, \q y desde tiempos pasados lo que aún no ha sucedido. \q Digo que {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} plan se mantendrá \q y que haré todo lo que deseo.
es.R: Desde el mismo principio digo lo que pasará al final. \q Hace mucho tiempo hablé de cosas que todavía no habían pasado. \q Digo que {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} planes se cumplirán. \q Haré todo lo que quiero hacer.

fr.L: annonçant dès le commencement la fin, \q et dès les temps anciens ce qui n’a pas [encore] été fait, \q disant : {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} dessein tiendra, \q et tout {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} désir, je l’accomplirai,
fr.B: Dès le début, j’annonce comment les choses finiront, \q et depuis les temps passés, ce qui n’est pas encore arrivé. \q Je dis que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} projet tiendra \q et que j’accomplirai tout ce que je désire.
fr.R: Dès le tout début, j’annonce ce qui arrivera à la fin. \q Il y a longtemps, j’ai parlé de choses qui n’étaient pas encore arrivées. \q Je dis que {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} projets se réaliseront. \q Je ferai tout ce que je veux faire.

sw.L: nitangazaye mwisho tangu mwanzo, \q na tangu nyakati za kale [mambo] ambayo bado hayajafanyika, \q nisemaye, Shauri {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} litasimama, \q nami nitafanya mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} yote,
sw.B: Tangu mwanzo ninatangaza jinsi mambo yatakavyoishia, \q na tangu nyakati za kale yale ambayo bado hayajatokea. \q Ninasema kwamba mpango {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} utasimama \q na kwamba nitatekeleza yote ninayoyapenda.
sw.R: Hata mwanzoni kabisa ninasema yatakayotokea mwishoni. \q Zamani niliwaambia mambo ambayo yalikuwa bado hayajatokea. \q Ninasema kwamba mipango {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} itatimia. \q Nitafanya kila kitu ninachotaka kufanya.

vi.L: Đấng từ ban đầu đã báo cuối cùng, \q và từ thuở xưa [báo] những [việc] chưa xảy ra, \q Đấng phán: Mưu định {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đứng vững, \q và mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} muốn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm,
vi.B: Từ buổi đầu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã báo trước mọi việc sẽ kết thúc thế nào, \q và từ thuở xa xưa {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã báo những gì chưa xảy ra. \q Ta phán rằng kế hoạch của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đứng vững \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ thực hiện mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} muốn.
vi.R: Ngay từ ban đầu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã nói điều sẽ xảy ra vào lúc cuối cùng. \q Từ lâu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã nói về những việc chưa xảy ra. \q Ta phán rằng các kế hoạch của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ thành sự thật. \q Ta sẽ làm mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} muốn làm.

decisions.choice: declaring, saying: these describe the God who speaks in verse 9
decisions.reason: The verbs are participles that continue 'I am God' from verse 9: he is the God who foretells and then fulfills. The sentence runs on into verse 11.

decisions.choice: my purpose will stand: God's plan will come about
decisions.reason: The word is used of a counsel or plan; to 'stand' means to be carried out and not overturned (14:24; 8:10; Proverbs 19:21).

decisions.choice: all my desire: everything God wills
decisions.reason: The word means what pleases someone, what they choose and intend (44:28; 48:14; 53:10).

source.text: קֹרֵ֤א מִמִּזְרָח֙ עַ֔יִט מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מֶרְחָ֖ק אִ֣ישׁ עֲצָתִ֑י אַף־דִּבַּ֨רְתִּי֙ אַף־אֲבִיאֶ֔נָּה יָצַ֖רְתִּי אַף־אֶעֱשֶֽׂנָּה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: calling from [the] east a bird of prey, from a land of distance [the] man of my purpose. Indeed I have spoken, indeed I will bring it; I have planned, indeed I will do it.

en.L: calling from [the] east a bird of prey, \q from a far land the man of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} purpose. \q Yes, I have spoken; yes, I will bring it [about]; \q I have planned [it]; yes, I will do it.
en.B: Out of the east I call a bird of prey, \q from a far country the man who serves {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} plan. \q I have spoken it, and I will bring it to pass; \q I have shaped it, and I will see it done.
en.R: I am calling a man from a country far to the east. \q He will swoop down like a bird that hunts its prey. He will carry out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} plans. \q I have said it, and I will make it happen. \q I have planned it, and I will do it.

es.L: que llamo desde el oriente al ave de rapiña, \q y de tierra lejana al hombre de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} consejo. \q Sí, he hablado; sí, lo haré venir; \q lo he planeado; sí, lo haré.
es.B: Desde el oriente llamo a un ave de rapiña, \q desde un país lejano al hombre que cumple {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} plan. \q Lo he dicho, y lo haré realidad; \q lo he planeado, y lo llevaré a cabo.
es.R: Estoy llamando a un hombre de un país lejano, al oriente. \q Se lanzará como un ave que caza su presa. Llevará a cabo {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} planes. \q Lo he dicho, y haré que suceda. \q Lo he planeado, y lo haré.

fr.L: appelant de l’orient un oiseau de proie, \q d’une terre lointaine l’homme de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} dessein. \q Oui, j’ai parlé ; oui, je [le] ferai arriver ; \q j’ai formé [ce projet] ; oui, je l’exécuterai.
fr.B: De l’orient j’appelle un oiseau de proie, \q d’un pays lointain l’homme qui sert {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} projet. \q Je l’ai dit, et je le ferai arriver ; \q je l’ai conçu, et je le réaliserai.
fr.R: J’appelle un homme d’un pays loin à l’est. \q Il fondra comme un oiseau qui chasse sa proie. Il réalisera {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} projets. \q Je l’ai dit, et je le ferai arriver. \q Je l’ai prévu, et je le ferai.

sw.L: nikiita kutoka mashariki ndege mla nyama, \q kutoka nchi ya mbali mtu wa shauri {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}. \q Naam, nimesema; naam, nitalileta; \q nimekusudia; naam, nitalitenda.
sw.B: Kutoka mashariki ninamwita ndege mla nyama, \q kutoka nchi ya mbali mtu atakayetimiza mpango {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. \q Nimelisema, nami nitalitimiza; \q nimelipanga, nami nitaliona likitendeka.
sw.R: Ninamwita mtu kutoka nchi iliyo mbali upande wa mashariki. \q Atashuka kwa kasi kama ndege anayewinda mawindo yake. Atatekeleza mipango {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. \q Nimesema, nami nitalifanya litokee. \q Nimelipanga, nami nitalifanya.

vi.L: Đấng gọi chim săn mồi từ phương đông, \q gọi người [thực hiện] mưu định {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} từ xứ xa xôi. \q Phải, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phán; phải, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho [điều đó] đến; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã định [điều đó]; phải, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm.
vi.B: Từ phương đông {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} gọi một con chim săn mồi, \q từ xứ xa xôi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} gọi người phục vụ kế hoạch của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Ta đã phán, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho thành tựu; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã hoạch định, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho hoàn tất.
vi.R: Ta đang gọi một người từ một xứ xa xôi ở phương đông. \q Người sẽ lao xuống như chim săn mồi. Người sẽ thực hiện các kế hoạch của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Ta đã nói, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho điều đó xảy ra. \q Ta đã định, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm.

decisions.choice: a bird of prey from the east: a picture of the conqueror God is sending, Cyrus
decisions.reason: The word is used of birds that swoop on a carcass (Genesis 15:11). Here it pictures a swift, fierce conqueror. He is not named in this verse, but he is the one God calls from the east in 41:2 and 41:25 and names as Cyrus in 44:28 and 45:1.

decisions.choice: the man of my purpose: the man who carries out God's plan (the reading the Masoretes marked to be read)
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the text read 'the man of his purpose', while the Masoretic note gives 'my purpose' as the word to be read. 'My purpose' matches verse 10, where the same word is God's plan. 'His purpose' would mean the man whom God's plan chose, or the man who has his own plan; the sense is close either way.

decisions.choice: I have spoken, I will bring it; I have planned, I will do it: what God says and plans, he carries out
decisions.reason: Each past verb is matched by a future one. The verb for 'planned' is the one used of a potter shaping clay (45:9, 18), and it echoes 37:26.

decisions.choice: a man ... will swoop down like a bird that hunts its prey
decisions.reason: Readable explains the image: the bird of prey is the man God calls.

source.text: שִׁמְע֥וּ אֵלַ֖י אַבִּ֣ירֵי לֵ֑ב הָרְחוֹקִ֖ים מִצְּדָקָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Listen to me, mighty of heart, the [ones] far from righteousness.

en.L: Listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, [you] mighty of heart, \q who are far from righteousness:
en.B: Listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, you hard of heart, \q standing far off from righteousness.
en.R: Listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, you stubborn people. \q You are far from righteousness.

es.L: {{plural_you:Escúchenme|Escuchadme}} a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, duros de corazón, \q que [están] lejos de la justicia:
es.B: {{plural_you:Escúchenme|Escuchadme}} a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los de corazón endurecido, \q que se mantienen lejos de la justicia.
es.R: {{plural_you:Escúchenme|Escuchadme}} a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, gente terca. \q {{plural_you:Ustedes están|Vosotros estáis}} lejos de la justicia.

fr.L: Écoutez-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, [vous] les forts de cœur, \q qui êtes loin de la justice :
fr.B: Écoutez-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, vous qui avez le cœur dur, \q qui vous tenez loin de la justice.
fr.R: Écoutez-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, gens têtus. \q Vous êtes loin de la justice.

sw.L: Nisikilizeni, [enyi] wenye mioyo migumu, \q mlio mbali na haki:
sw.B: Nisikilizeni, enyi wenye mioyo migumu, \q mliosimama mbali na haki.
sw.R: Nisikilizeni, enyi watu wakaidi. \q Mko mbali na haki.

vi.L: Hãy nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, [hỡi những kẻ] cứng lòng, \q là những kẻ xa cách sự công chính:
vi.B: Hãy lắng nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, hỡi những kẻ lòng cứng cỏi, \q những kẻ đứng xa sự công chính.
vi.R: Hãy nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, hỡi những kẻ ương ngạnh. \q Các ngươi đang ở xa điều công chính.

decisions.choice: mighty of heart: stubborn, proud, set in their own way
decisions.reason: The phrase is used of fierce warriors in Psalm 76:6. Here, said to God's own people, it means those who harden themselves against him (verse 8, 'rebels'; 48:4).

decisions.choice: far from righteousness: far from the right standing that God's saving justice gives
alternatives: far from doing what is right
decisions.reason: In verse 13 God says that his righteousness is not far. The people feel far from it, either because of their sin or because they do not believe God will act for them. Both are in view (45:8; 51:5).

source.text: קֵרַ֤בְתִּי צִדְקָתִי֙ לֹ֣א תִרְחָ֔ק וּתְשׁוּעָתִ֖י לֹ֣א תְאַחֵ֑ר וְנָתַתִּ֤י בְצִיּוֹן֙ תְּשׁוּעָ֔ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תִּפְאַרְתִּֽי׃ס

records.literal_gloss: I have brought near my righteousness; not it will be far, and my salvation not it will delay; and I will give in Zion salvation, to Israel my splendor.

en.L: I have brought near {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} righteousness; it is not far off, \q and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} salvation will not delay; \q and I will put salvation in Zion, \q [and give] to Israel {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} splendor.
en.B: My righteousness I have brought near; it is close at hand, \q and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} salvation will not linger. \q In Zion I will set salvation, \q and on Israel I will bestow {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} splendor.
en.R: I am bringing {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} righteousness near. It is not far away. \q My salvation will come soon. \q I will bring salvation to Zion. \q I will give {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} splendor to Israel.

es.L: He acercado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} justicia; no está lejos, \q y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} salvación no se tardará; \q y pondré salvación en Sion, \q [y daré] a Israel {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} esplendor.
es.B: He acercado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} justicia; está muy cerca, \q y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} salvación no se demorará. \q En Sion pondré la salvación, \q y sobre Israel derramaré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} esplendor.
es.R: Estoy acercando {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} justicia. No está lejos. \q Mi salvación vendrá pronto. \q Traeré salvación a Sion. \q Daré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} esplendor a Israel.

fr.L: J’ai fait approcher {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} justice ; elle n’est pas loin, \q et {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} salut ne tardera pas ; \q et je mettrai le salut dans Sion, \q [et je donnerai] à Israël {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} splendeur.
fr.B: J’ai fait approcher {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} justice ; elle est toute proche, \q et {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} salut ne se fera pas attendre. \q Je placerai le salut dans Sion, \q et j’accorderai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} splendeur à Israël.
fr.R: J’approche {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} justice. Elle n’est pas loin. \q Mon salut viendra bientôt. \q J’apporterai le salut à Sion. \q Je donnerai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} splendeur à Israël.

sw.L: Nimeileta karibu haki {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}; haiko mbali, \q na wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} hautakawia; \q nami nitaweka wokovu katika Sayuni, \q [na kumpa] Israeli fahari {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.
sw.B: Haki {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} nimeileta karibu; iko karibu kabisa, \q na wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} hautachelewa. \q Katika Sayuni nitaweka wokovu, \q na juu ya Israeli nitaweka fahari {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.
sw.R: Ninaileta haki {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} karibu. Haiko mbali. \q Wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} utakuja upesi. \q Nitaleta wokovu kwa Sayuni. \q Nitampa Israeli fahari {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.

vi.L: Ta đã đem sự công chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đến gần; nó không ở xa, \q và sự cứu rỗi của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không chậm trễ; \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đặt sự cứu rỗi trong Si-ôn, \q [và ban] cho Y-sơ-ra-ên sự huy hoàng của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Ta đã đem sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đến gần; nó đã kề bên, \q và sự cứu rỗi của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không trì hoãn. \q Ta sẽ đặt sự cứu rỗi tại Si-ôn, \q và ban cho Y-sơ-ra-ên vẻ huy hoàng của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Ta đang đem điều công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đến gần. Nó không còn xa nữa. \q Sự giải cứu của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đến sớm. \q Ta sẽ đem sự giải cứu đến cho Si-ôn. \q Ta sẽ ban vẻ huy hoàng của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cho Y-sơ-ra-ên.

decisions.choice: my righteousness, my salvation: God's act of putting things right for his people
decisions.reason: The two words stand in parallel: God's righteousness here is his saving justice, the act by which he keeps his promises and rescues Israel (45:8; 51:5-6; 56:1).

decisions.choice: I have brought near: the coming rescue is so certain it is told as done
decisions.reason: The verb is past in form, but the next lines speak of what God will do.

decisions.choice: to Israel my splendor: God will give his splendor to Israel
decisions.reason: The words can also be read 'for Israel, my splendor', calling Israel the people in whom God shows his beauty (44:23; 49:3). The meaning is close either way.
